title: fix: custom reports showing excluded empty category rows
issueTitle: [Bug]: Custom Reports - show empty rows option ignores unchecked catgeories
why: The only difference the report describes is that categories the user unchecked show up as extra $0.00 rows in the buggy build, so the fixed build has no single visible text of its own to check: the test would have to check that rows are absent or count them, and it would rely on the custom-report category-checkbox screen, which the report does not describe clearly enough to script.
